approaches.title: Graph reachability with invocation-boundary validation
approaches.summary: Build a directed call graph, find all methods reachable from the suspicious method using iterative DFS, then verify that no non-suspicious method invokes a suspicious one. Return either all methods or only the non-suspicious methods.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial iterative graph traversal marks methods reachable from k, then scans non-suspicious methods for calls into the suspicious set.
Improves the DFS by marking k before traversal and marking each neighbor when pushed, avoiding duplicate stack processing.
Combines result construction with the validation scan, eliminating a separate filtering pass.
